verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance is documented as generative and agentic AI embedded across the platform. It ships several built-in agents that take on work: the SRE Agent diagnoses and remediates incidents and can be armed with Skills, the Scribe Agent can be scheduled to join and transcribe incident calls, the Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention, and the Insights Agent answers conversational queries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice, and detailed docs on the user-facing interface for assigning ad-hoc tasks to the agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: PagerDuty Advance is a set of generative and agentic AI capabilities embedded across the PagerDuty Operations Cloud
From AI agents handling well-understood tasks to generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident, PagerDuty Advance augments, guides, and resolves operational work.
SRE Agent handles incidents and fixes. You step in when it matters.
Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
monitors calendars, detects potential conflicts, identifies qualified replacements, and coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention
delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics
users can configure Skills to arm the SRE Agent with instructions, scripts, and resources that give it specialized capabilities and domain expertise
